error.message: {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "error": {"code": -32603, "message": "Internal error", "data": {"details": "This session is in use by another Kimi Code CLI instance. Stop the session in that instance or exit it, then try again."}}}

route: Exact-stop this session (stop --repo REPO --session SESSION --expected-holder-instance-id ID), attest, then start --resume NATIVE_ID. If resume still fails, start a fresh Host session and hand it the summary from status, capture --lines 200, list --repo --include-dead, and delegator view (goals, decisions, in-flight tasks, live seats and holders, pending items). The new Host re-adopts live seats from that list. Do not retry the dead session. This build does not auto-reap an unowned exited job.
